description: Republican nominee for governor Ty Masterson is refusing to debate Senator Holscher again. His spokesperson confirmed to the Kansas Reflector that Masterson has “no plans to accept any further debates.” Masterson’s retreat comes less than a week after the two faced off at the Kansas State Fair, where Holscher hammered him over his 20-year record in the legislature and six years running the Senate.

title: Masterson Confirms: No More Debates | Cindy Holscher for Governor
